reason: The patch's ensure_embeddable sets response.headers['X-Frame-Options'] = "ALLOWALL" (change.patch line 204, spec at line 841), but X-Frame-Options only allows DENY, SAMEORIGIN or ALLOW-FROM (RFC 7034). Framing works only because browsers ignore the unknown value, which effectively drops Rails' default SAMEORIGIN; removing the header would be the cleaner fix.
